name: Cash Flow - Operação e Carga
description: Dashboard para acompanhar traces, erros, latência, throughput e logs do Core.Api e Summary.Api enviados via OpenTelemetry.

pages.name: APIs e carga
pages.description: Sinais principais da aplicação durante testes funcionais e de carga.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE error IS TRUE OR http.response.status_code >= 500 FACET service.name SINCE 1 hour ago
FROM Span SELECT count(*), percentile(duration.ms, 95) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') FACET http.route, service.name SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50
FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') FACET severity.text, service.name SINCE 1 hour ago

FROM Span SELECT count(*), average(duration.ms) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') AND (messaging.system IS NOT NULL OR db.system IS NOT NULL OR category = 'http') FACET messaging.system, messaging.destination.name, db.system, server.address SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50
FROM Span SELECT count(*), average(duration.ms), percentile(duration.ms, 95) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') FACET service.name SINCE 1 hour ago
FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') FACET name TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') AND (error IS TRUE OR http.response.status_code >= 400) FACET http.route, service.name, http.response.status_code SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') FACET http.route, service.name SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50
FROM Span SELECT count(*), average(duration.ms) WHERE messaging.system = 'rabbitmq' FACET service.name, messaging.operation.type, messaging.destination.name SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50

FROM Span SELECT count(*), percentile(duration.ms, 95), max(duration.ms) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') AND span.kind = 'client' FACET peer.service, db.system, name SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50

FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') AND (businessEvent IS NOT NULL OR BusinessEvent IS NOT NULL) FACET businessEvent, BusinessEvent, service.name SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50

FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE http.response.status_code < 500) WHERE service.name IN ('cash-flow-core-api', 'cash-flow-summary-api') AND http.route = '/readyz' FACET service.name TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 1 hour ago
